name: Malayan Cement Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权及股份分拆相关的附加上市公告。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比增长16.6%，净利润同比增长34.8%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract awards for its business segments in its announcements; announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividend book closures, and additional listing announcements related to share subdivision. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 16.6% year-on-year and net profit grew 34.8% year-on-year.
